spans.s:
a-gadá, a. not having disease, well, healthy,
whole; wholesome; as m. medicine.

āgantu, m. arrival; and so, as in Eng.,
person arriving. [√gam + ā, 1161.]

āgamana, n. a coming hither; w. punar,
a returning. [√gam + ā.]

ā́gas, n. sin. [orig., perhaps, ‘a slip,’
√añj: cf. ἄγος, ‘guilt’: different is ἅγος,
see √yaj.]
